positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: what makes intelligence 'owned' rather than merely 'rented', and which layer of it is the asset that persists?
positions.why: src-2 and src-3 together draw one distinction: intelligence held as substrate (a commodity, replaceable, akin to something rented) versus intelligence held as perspective (the asset that is kept). src-4 explicitly names and restates this as 'the individually-owned-intelligence thesis,' confirming the same directional read rather than introducing a separate one — it is positioning language pointing back at the same claim, not a new claim. Pass-2 found no prior position in the perspective for src-4 to bind to (the map and area index carry nothing under this theme), so this is fresh space: a mint, not an attach.
